# Tool reference

Every tool the server registers with all apps enabled. Tools marked
**read-only** are the only ones left with `--read-only`.

The edit ops behind `word_exec` and the anchor ids every tool uses are
documented in the Word guide (`word_read(command="guide")`, or the
`office-mcp://word/guide` resource).

## Word

### `word_read`

**Read Word document** (read-only)

Read the Word document open on this PC. Never changes it.

Start with status (open documents), then outline (headings with their anchor ids).
Anchor ids from these reads are what word_exec ops target.

Commands, with the fields they take:
- Orient: status, outline (all_paragraphs), paragraphs (start, count), sections, stats, styles
- Locate: find (text, in_anchor) returns range: ids; find_paragraphs (text, limit, min_score) fuzzy; location (anchor_id); nearest_heading (anchor_id, direction)
- Text: read_text (anchor_id, view), read_section (anchor_id or heading), between (start_anchor, end_anchor, inclusive), read_bookmark (name), read_cc (name)
- Whole document: to_markdown (within), to_html (within), digest (budget, depth) for a large document
- Tables: table_list, table_read (table), table_records (table)
- Objects: images, read_image (anchor_id) returns the picture, shapes, equations, charts, footnotes, endnotes, hyperlinks, fields, comments, revisions, track
- Design: properties, variables, theme, themes, format_info (anchor_id), list_levels (anchor_id)
- Quality: proofing, lint (rules, within)
- Changes: checkpoint (include, within) returns a token; diff (checkpoint, or cp_a and cp_b) lists what changed since
- guide: how anchors work and every word_exec op. Read it once before your first edit.

Large results are truncated with a note saying how to narrow the request.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `command` | `guide` \| `status` \| `outline` \| `paragraphs` \| `sections` \| `stats` \| `styles` \| `find` \| `find_paragraphs` \| `location` \| `nearest_heading` \| `read_text` \| `read_section` \| `between` \| `read_bookmark` \| `read_cc` \| `to_markdown` \| `to_html` \| `digest` \| `table_list` \| `table_read` \| `table_records` \| `images` \| `read_image` \| `shapes` \| `equations` \| `charts` \| `footnotes` \| `endnotes` \| `hyperlinks` \| `fields` \| `comments` \| `revisions` \| `track` \| `properties` \| `variables` \| `theme` \| `themes` \| `format_info` \| `list_levels` \| `proofing` \| `lint` \| `checkpoint` \| `diff` | yes | What to read. |
| `doc` | string | no | Document name from word_read(command="status"); omit for the active one. |
| `anchor_id` | string | no | Anchor id such as heading:12, para:3, range:40-55, bookmark:NAME, cc:NAME, table:1:2:3 or image:1. For read_text, read_section, location, nearest_heading, format_info, list_levels, read_image. |
| `text` | string | no | Text to look for (find, find_paragraphs). |
| `name` | string | no | Bookmark or content-control name (read_bookmark, read_cc). |
| `heading` | string | no | Heading text, instead of anchor_id (read_section). |
| `start` | integer | no | First paragraph, 1-based (paragraphs). |
| `count` | integer | no | How many paragraphs (paragraphs). |
| `all_paragraphs` | boolean | no | List every paragraph, not just headings (outline). |
| `in_anchor` | string | no | Only search inside this anchor (find). |
| `limit` | integer | no | Most candidates, default 5 (find_paragraphs). |
| `min_score` | number | no | Lowest similarity, 0-1, default 0.6 (find_paragraphs). |
| `direction` | `before` \| `after` | no | Search direction (nearest_heading). |
| `view` | `raw` \| `final` \| `original` \| `segments` | no | raw text, as if tracked changes were accepted (final) or rejected (original), or per-revision segments (read_text). |
| `start_anchor` | string | no | Anchor the span starts at (between). |
| `end_anchor` | string | no | Anchor the span ends at (between). |
| `inclusive` | boolean | no | Include both end anchors (between). |
| `within` | string | no | Limit to one anchor, usually a heading's section (to_markdown, to_html, lint, checkpoint). |
| `budget` | integer | no | Token budget, default 6000 (digest). |
| `depth` | integer | no | Deepest heading level (digest). |
| `table` | integer | no | Table number, 1-based (table_read, table_records). |
| `rules` | string[] | no | Lint rules to run; default all (lint). |
| `include` | `text` \| `text+style` \| `text+format` | no | What the fingerprint covers (checkpoint). |
| `checkpoint` | any | no | A checkpoint to compare with the document now (diff). |
| `cp_a` | any | no | Older checkpoint, with cp_b (diff). |
| `cp_b` | any | no | Newer checkpoint, with cp_a (diff). |

### `word_exec`

**Edit Word document** (changes documents or files)

Edit the Word document: apply a list of ops as one undo step for the user.

Each op is an object {"op": "<name>", ...fields}. Ops target anchor ids from word_read (heading:N, para:N, range:S-E, bookmark:NAME, table:N:R:C, start, end ...). Ops run in order and each resolves its anchor against the document as it is at that moment.

If any op fails, every op before it is rolled back, so the document is unchanged. The error names the failing op (failure.index) and says how to fix it; fix that op and resend the whole batch. On success the result lists each op's outputs (new table index, pin id, shape id ...) and warns about fields an op ignored.

Common ops: insert_paragraph, insert_block, insert_markdown, replace, find_replace, delete_paragraph, apply_style, format_run, format_paragraph, apply_list, create_table, set_cell, insert_image, add_comment, write_header, insert_toc.
To add long content (a chapter from Markdown), send it whole in one insert_markdown op: headings, lists and pipe tables all land in order.
The full op list with required fields is in word_read(command="guide"); read it once before your first edit.

Example: {"ops": [{"op": "insert_paragraph", "anchor_id": "heading:4", "text": "New paragraph."}, {"op": "find_replace", "find": "Q3", "text": "Q4", "all": true}]}

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ops` | object[] | yes | Ops to apply in order. Each is {"op": "<name>", ...fields}; see word_read(command="guide"). |
| `label` | string | no | Name of the undo step the user sees in Word. |
| `tracked` | boolean | no | Record the whole batch as tracked changes. |
| `doc` | string | no | Document name from word_read(command="status"); omit for the active one. |

### `word_snapshot`

**Render Word pages** (read-only)

Render pages of the Word document as PNG images, so you can check layout, styling and placement the way the user sees it. Never changes the document.

Pass pages ("4" or "2-5") or an anchor (renders the page(s) it sits on). Without either, every page is rendered, up to the server's page limit. Use markup="all" to see tracked changes and comments. Images cost tokens: render only the pages you need.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pages` | string | no | One page ("4") or a range ("2-5"). Omit for every page. |
| `anchor` | string | no | Render the page(s) this anchor is on instead; a heading covers its whole section. |
| `dpi` | integer | no | Render resolution. |
| `max_dim` | integer | no | Cap on each page's long edge in pixels (default: the server's --snapshot-max-dim). |
| `markup` | `none` \| `all` | no | all = show tracked changes and comments. |
| `doc` | string | no | Document name from word_read(command="status"); omit for the active one. |

### `word_write`

**Open, save or export a Word document** (changes documents or files)

Open, save or export a Word document, or turn Track Changes on or off.

- open (path): open a local .docx in Word (starts Word if needed); activates it if already open.
- save: save the document to its current file.
- save_as (path, overwrite): save to a new .docx.
- export_pdf (path, from_page, to_page): write a PDF copy.
- track (on): turn Track Changes on or off.

Saving and exporting only write inside the folders the server was configured to allow; otherwise they fail with path_not_allowed. Edits go through word_exec, not this tool.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `command` | `open` \| `save` \| `save_as` \| `export_pdf` \| `track` | yes | What to do. |
| `path` | string | no | Local file path: the document to open (open), or the target file (save_as, export_pdf). |
| `overwrite` | boolean | no | Replace an existing file (save_as). |
| `from_page` | integer | no | First page to export (export_pdf). |
| `to_page` | integer | no | Last page to export (export_pdf). |
| `on` | boolean | no | Turn Track Changes on or off (track). |
| `doc` | string | no | Document name from word_read(command="status"); omit for the active one. |
